note: Unknown state. The enum is the vocabulary a consumer can answer for; `complete` is not in it, because a completed job is deleted rather than listed.
Snake_case state — SPEC §4.10 makes wire enums lowerCamelCase, and `in_flight` is the spelling an implementation reading its own internal enum would send.
limit above the ceiling. 200 is the maximum the maintainer clamps to; a request for more must be refused rather than silently reduced, so a caller cannot believe it received a complete page.
limit of zero. minimum 1 stops a page request that can only return nothing.
Unknown top-level member — additionalProperties: false catches `memberDid`, which a caller might assume filters the list.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
